queries.catalogSql:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'functions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'signature',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||replace(oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes),', ',',')||')','oid',p.oid,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),
 'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl,'config',p.proconfig,
 'definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,
 'strict',p.proisstrict,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'source_md5',md5(p.prosrc)) order by n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes))
 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where p.oid in(select to_regprocedure(s) from unnest(array['private.expense_cost_finalize()','private.read_expense_document(text,uuid)','private.refresh_automatic_payment_certificate(uuid,uuid,date)','private.expense_cost_direction_v2_enabled(uuid)','private.expense_payment_v2_envelope(uuid,uuid,uuid,date,integer,numeric,jsonb)','private.expense_payment_v2_guard()','private.expense_payment_direction_capability(uuid)','public.expense_payment_direction_capability(uuid)']) s)),'[]'::jsonb),
 'triggers',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',t.oid,'table',t.tgrelid::regclass::text,
 'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true),'function',p.oid::regprocedure::text,
 'source_md5',md5(p.prosrc)) order by t.tgrelid::regclass::text,t.tgname)
 from pg_trigger t join pg_proc p on p.oid=t.tgfoid where not t.tgisinternal and
 (t.tgrelid='public.payment_certificates'::regclass or t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure('private.expense_cost_finalize()'))),'[]'::jsonb),
 'event_triggers',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',e.oid,'name',e.evtname,'event',e.evtevent,
 'enabled',e.evtenabled,'tags',e.evttags,'function',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'source_md5',md5(p.prosrc)) order by e.evtname)
 from pg_event_trigger e join pg_proc p on p.oid=e.evtfoid),'[]'::jsonb)) value
queries.defaultOffBusinessHashSql:
select md5(jsonb_build_object(
 'payments',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]') from public.payment_certificates x),
 'claims',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]') from private.expense_claims x),
 'choices',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]') from private.expense_settlement_choices x),
 'consumptions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]') from private.expense_amount_consumptions x),
 'snapshots',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]') from private.expense_document_snapshots x)
)::text) value
